# Tangison Technologies CC

> Tangison Technologies CC is a 100% Namibian owned technology company in Windhoek. It builds the systems that keep Namibian businesses and institutions running under imperfect conditions.

Tangison Technologies CC is a registered Close Corporation in Namibia (BIPA registry), founded and operated in Windhoek by Tangi Iigonda. We build the systems institutions run on: information and communications technology, applied artificial intelligence, digital transformation services, strategic and technical consulting, and applied research and development.

This is the corporate capability statement of the company. For client work and design, see Tangison Studio at https://studio.tangison.com.
